warmup.label: warmup
warmup.instruction: Warm-up: rally or hit easy shots as you like. Not labelled.

blocks.label: serve_short
blocks.instruction: Forehand Short serve: low, just over the net, landing close to the front service line. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: serve_short
blocks.instruction: Backhand Short serve: low, just over the net, landing close to the front service line. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: serve_long
blocks.instruction: Forehand Long serve: high and deep, landing on the back line. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: serve_long
blocks.instruction: Backhand Long serve: high and deep, landing on the back line. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: clear
blocks.instruction: Forehand Clear: full overhead, high and deep to the back line. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: clear
blocks.instruction: Backhand Clear: full overhead, high and deep to the back line. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: smash
blocks.instruction: Forehand Smash: full-power overhead, hit steeply downward. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: smash
blocks.instruction: Backhand Smash: full-power overhead, hit steeply downward. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: drop
blocks.instruction: Forehand Overhead drop: the same preparation as a clear, a soft shot that lands near the net. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: drop
blocks.instruction: Backhand Overhead drop: the same preparation as a clear, a soft shot that lands near the net. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: drive
blocks.instruction: Forehand Drive: flat and fast at about shoulder height, no lift or dip. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: drive
blocks.instruction: Backhand Drive: flat and fast at about shoulder height, no lift or dip. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: lift
blocks.instruction: Forehand Lift: underarm, from low near the net, high and deep to the back. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: lift
blocks.instruction: Backhand Lift: underarm, from low near the net, high and deep to the back. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: net_shot
blocks.instruction: Forehand Net shot: a soft touch from the net, the shuttle just clears the tape and drops. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: net_shot
blocks.instruction: Backhand Net shot: a soft touch from the net, the shuttle just clears the tape and drops. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: block_push
blocks.instruction: Forehand Block / push: a short, compact stroke at the net or mid-court, no big swing. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: block_push
blocks.instruction: Backhand Block / push: a short, compact stroke at the net or mid-court, no big swing. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: net_kill
blocks.instruction: Forehand Net kill: a quick downward put-away from above tape height at the net. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: net_kill
blocks.instruction: Backhand Net kill: a quick downward put-away from above tape height at the net. Hold still ~2 s between reps.

blocks.label: not_a_hit
blocks.instruction: Not a hit: for 60 s do waggles, walk about, pick up shuttles and shadow-move. No real strokes.

finale.label: free
finale.instruction: Free play: rally or play points, anything goes. Not labelled (the video labels it later).
